In this snapshot, the default multiprocessing start method on POSIX platforms other than macOS is `fork`.

```json
{"facts": {"default": "fork"}}
```

The "Contexts and start methods" section of `library/multiprocessing.rst` says of *fork*: "Available on POSIX systems. Currently the default on POSIX except macOS." The same section notes that the default will change away from *fork* in Python 3.14. It does not name a replacement, and this snapshot has not made that change yet. The 3.8 note in that file confirms that macOS uses *spawn* instead.

Supporting paths:
- `library/multiprocessing.rst`
- `deprecations/pending-removal-in-3.14.rst`, which says *fork* is currently the default on non-macOS POSIX platforms
- `whatsnew/3.12.rst`, which gives the same notice
